cues: In the house is a child with polio.
He cannot speak, move his hands, chew, or even spit.
The tourist said the East is always giving to the West.
Here, says the guide, is a child who can neither give nor take anything at all.
And he confesses: he told the parents the tourist is a doctor.
Now they smile at him with faith, as if he were their eldest son, home with a cure from across the seven seas.
Every one of the tourist's phrases, turned inside out.
